items.source: TextIndexed marks a field to be part of the text index. As there can be only one text index per collection all fields marked with TextIndexed are combined into one single index.
items.translation: TextIndexed 标记字段作为文本索引的一部分。由于每个集合只能有一个文本索引，所有使用 TextIndexed 标记的字段将被合并为一个单一的索引。

items.source:
Defines the significance of the filed relative to other indexed fields. The value directly influences the documents score.
Defaulted to 1.0.
items.translation:
定义该字段相对于其他已索引字段的显著性。该值直接影响文档分数。
默认值为 1.0。
